title: sagina maritima var. filiformis
intro: Sagina maritima var. filiformis, commonly known as sea pearlwort, is a type of flowering plant in the caryophyllaceae family. It is a perennial, succulent plant that thrives in coastal areas and is known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of sea pearlwort include its ability to soothe and calm skin irritations, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of sea pearlwort include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
